schema.description: Record a PERIOD approval decision or denial of a pending request.

approved_increase_amount.description: Positive increase amount to record, required only for approval.
approved_increase_amount.title: PlatformApprovedIncreaseAmount

scope.description: Approval scope; omission selects PERIOD. ONGOING returns 503 on this API.
scope.title: PlatformRequestScope

resolution_target.description: Approval breadth; USER or ALL only. Required for an ONGOING approval.

resolution_target_id.description: Not accepted for new approvals. Stored GROUP and DEPARTMENT records retain their identifiers in request responses.

resolution_note.description: Optional note recorded when denying the request.

allOf.description: Shared resolution target and identifier pairings.

oneOf.description: Omitted resolution fields for an unresolved request or PERIOD approval.

scope.description: Only PERIOD can omit the resolution target when scope is present.

oneOf.description: USER and ALL do not have a separate resolution target identifier.
GROUP and DEPARTMENT require their corresponding identifier.

resolution_target_id.description: The idp_group_id of an IdP group, or an explicit department name.

allOf.title: PlatformRequestResolutionFields

allOf.description: Approval records an increase amount; denial can record a note.

oneOf.description: Record approval with a positive increase amount.

not.description: Approval does not record a resolution note.

oneOf.description: A PERIOD approval records a current-month grant; existing enforcement consumes eligible USER grants.

scope.description: Period approval, also selected when scope is omitted.

oneOf.description: ONGOING input is recognized but returns 503 without changing the request.

not.description: Approval fields are not denial inputs.
